name: get_flag_settings
description:
Retrieve a project's Vercel Flags settings. Scope the call to the team that owns the project. A settings_not_found error usually means Vercel Flags has not been set up for the project: report that instead of retrying, and do not assume the project has flags.

CLI fallback on MCP failure (partial): vercel api /v1/projects/{projectIdOrName}/feature-flags/settings --method GET. Fill placeholders from inputs.

slug.description: Team slug to use for this operation. Use instead of teamId.

teamId.description: Team ID to use for this operation.
